verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is BigCommerce's own payments page, titled 'Ecommerce Payment Providers & Credit Card Solutions'. That title implies a choice of payment providers, but nothing describes third-party gateway selection in any depth. The Multi-Site 'Regions' page and the Checkout SDK do not establish multi-currency charging: one is an adjacent feature and the other a developer building block. Missing for 10: documented list or configuration of third-party payment gateways, evidence of multi-currency charging or settlement, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a merchant, I can choose among third-party payment gateways and charge in multiple currencies when the built-in option doesn't fit

citations.quote: Ecommerce Payment Providers & Credit Card Solutions
